This Moment

✉
Today
—

"If you're reading this someday, I hope we're still making memories like these."

My Love,

Every photo in this little gallery is proof of how far we've already come — and how much more there still is to write. Some of it is loud and unforgettable, most of it is quiet and ordinary, and somehow all of it has become my favourite part of being alive. I never want to lose a single piece of it.

A few things, though, I hope we never forget
  • The random laughs.
  • The quiet moments.
  • The silly little dances.
  • The sunsets.
  • The songs.
  • The way everything feels better when we're together.

Every single one of these — I want forever, with you.Yours, always. ♡
